identity_marker: medium-sized brown chicken egg, small brushed metal saucepan, and stainless steel slotted spoon
continuity_anchors: brightly lit modern kitchen with white marble countertops and warm overhead lighting
video_goal: Demonstrate the complete process of boiling, cooling, and peeling a chicken egg.
single_prompt: From an over-the-shoulder view, clear water pours from a glass pitcher into a small metal saucepan resting on a stovetop burner. A hand turns the stove dial clockwise to the 'High' position, and soon the water inside the saucepan reaches a rolling boil with large bubbles rapidly breaking the surface. A hand carefully places a raw brown chicken egg onto the center of a metal slotted spoon, gently lowering it to submerge the egg completely into the boiling water before pulling the empty spoon away. An index finger presses the 'Start' button on a digital kitchen timer that displays '07:00'. The brown egg vibrates and rolls slightly amidst the vigorously boiling water bubbles. Meanwhile, a hand drops a handful of ice cubes into a clear glass bowl filled with cold water to create an ice bath. The digital kitchen timer display flashes '00:00' as the countdown finishes. A hand uses the metal slotted spoon to scoop the boiled brown egg out of the bubbling water, lowering the hot egg directly into the glass bowl of ice water to rest among the ice cubes. A hand lifts the cooled egg from the ice bath and taps it firmly against a wooden cutting board to fracture the shell. Two thumbs peel away the fractured brown shell and inner membrane to reveal the smooth, white cooked egg underneath. Finally, a sharp knife slices the peeled white egg in half, separating the two halves to show a firm, bright yellow cooked yolk.
